verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a cloud-hosted editor and engine platform like PlayCanvas, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection, or any opt-out control. Self-hosting downloads and open-source engine availability are adjacent features, not a documented telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
